_comment: kreview project harness. Hooks are the deterministic floor (rules persuade, hooks enforce). Skills load from .claude/skills (symlink -> ../.agents/skills). graphify is advisory (see CLAUDE.md), not a per-tool gate. Paths under .claude/hooks are repo-relative and committed so the whole team shares them.

permissions._comment: Allowlist the read-only commands run constantly so they stop prompting. No denylist here: the injection-guard/rm-rf/env/gitleaks hooks are the real safety floor, not deny rules.

hooks.command: python3 -c "import json, sys, re; from datetime import datetime; d = json.load(sys.stdin); q = d.get('tool_input', {}).get('query', ''); has_year = re.search(r'\\b20\\d{2}\\b', q); has_temporal = any(w in q.lower() for w in ['latest','recent','current','new','now','today']); mq = f'{q} {datetime.now().year}' if not has_year and not has_temporal else q; print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'hookEventName': 'PreToolUse', 'modifiedToolInput': {'query': mq}}})); sys.exit(0)"
